subject.title: fix(voice-call): avoid OpenAI realtime double greeting

question: Should this PR remain blocked until the current head has live Twilio/OpenAI outbound-call proof showing one initial greeting, preserved caller interruption, and restored auto-response behavior?
rationale: The source and tests support the intended provider-owned fix, but the affected behavior depends on OpenAI Realtime and carrier timing; a reviewer already requested live proof and the PR still carries the needs-proof label.

options.title: Require live voice-call proof
options.body: Keep this PR blocked until a redacted live outbound call or equivalent live Realtime trace proves one greeting, interruption, and auto-response restoration on the current head.

options.title: Accept source-harness proof
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept focused tests and CI as sufficient, while owning the remaining live-provider timing risk.

options.title: Pause or close until proof exists
options.body: If nobody can provide live proof, pause the branch or close it in favor of a fresh proven fix later.

recommendation.title: Require live voice-call proof
recommendation.body: Keep this PR blocked until a redacted live outbound call or equivalent live Realtime trace proves one greeting, interruption, and auto-response restoration on the current head.
